initiatives.title: Swachhata Hi Seva 2026: cleanliness, waste management and community participation
initiatives.summary: Regional Labour Institute, Kolkata conducted campaign activities from 17 September to 2 October 2026, combining intensive premises cleaning, responsible disposal of obsolete items, public-place cleaning and community participation.
implementation: Intensively cleaned approximately 10,000 sq. ft. of institute premises and removed scrap and obsolete condemned items through disposal procedures.
Completed 38 Cleanliness Target Units (CTUs) and intensively cleaned 4 additional public places.
Organised the Swachhata pledge, 'Ek Din Ek Ghanta Ek Saath', and 'Ek Ped Maa Ke Naam' activities.
Conducted awareness on avoiding single-use plastics and cleanliness measures to reduce mosquito-breeding sites.
Organised a Safai Mitra health check-up and facilitation programme under Jan Bhagidari with the local municipality.
initiatives.impact: Approximately 10,000 sq. ft. cleaned; 38 CTUs completed; 4 additional public places cleaned; more than 350 man-hours contributed; more than ₹50,000 earned from disposal of scrap and obsolete condemned items.
initiatives.outcome: The campaign combined workplace upkeep, waste disposal, public-space cleanliness, environmental awareness and participation by officers, staff, students and programme participants. The activity model can be replicated by setting measurable cleaning targets, recording participation hours, documenting disposal proceeds and maintaining dated photographic evidence.
initiatives.resources: Cleaning materials and PPE as appropriate, designated teams, waste segregation and authorised disposal arrangements, coordination with the local municipality, and photographic/activity records.
